newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian February industrial output fell yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italian February industrial output fell yr/yr.

text.p: National Statistics Institute ISTAT gave the following provisional figures for industrial production, year-on-year, in February.
Note: (The industrial production index was rebased in January 1994 on 1990 levels, replacing a 1985-based index.)
-- Istat said average daily output, non-seasonally adjusted but workday adjusted, rose 0.8 percent year-on-year in February after falling 2.7 percent in January.
-- Production of consumer goods, on an unadjusted basis, fell 1.2 percent year-on-year in February. Intermediate goods fell 4.2 percent and final investment goods dropped 6.2 percent.

On an unadjusted basis, year-on-year, production of textile goods fell 5.0 percent year-on-year in February, leather goods fell 3.1 percent, petrol refinery output dropped five percent, rubber and plastics fell 0.7 percent, non-metal minerals fell five percent, metal products fell 7.9 percent, machinery fell 6.1 percent, electrical machinery fell 8.4 percent, food and tobacco goods production fell 1.9 percent and electric, gas and water energy production fell 6.3 percent.
-- By contrast, paper and paper product production rose 5.6 percent, chemicals and fibre production rose 1.9 percent and output of transport vehicles rose 0.4 percent.
